page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-64-lssd is an arm64-based server instance featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced resource distribution of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The instance operates on dedicated CPU allocation without hardware GPU acceleration, as the GPU count is zero.

The primary configuration lists local storage as none, and there are zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the instance. The arm64 architecture offers an alternative to traditional x86 platforms, focusing on resource density and power efficiency for modern cloud workloads.

With a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is classified under general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for multi-threaded applications, web serving, containerized microservices, and distributed application nodes that benefit from dedicated ARM-based processing cores and a balanced memory footprint.
